reuse.why: Follows the existing link.ts assertion pattern (next to assertAccountNotLinked) and calls one new helper from every provider; it re-queries the account that each linker loads again just after instead of checking the row it already reads.

duplication.why: The rule is defined once; only a one-line call is repeated in the six provider linkers, mirroring the tree's existing per-provider structure.

placement.why: The guard lives in accounts/link.ts beside the other linking invariants, and is invoked at the start of each link handler before any side effect.

scope.why: Only the six linkers, the new helper and focused tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Clear and consistent, though a future seventh provider must remember to add the call (as with assertAccountNotLinked).

one_place.where: link.assertAccountIsOpen in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/link.ts, called by all six link*Account functions in accounts/app.ts
